```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

Two-level DSEM decomposes intensive longitudinal observations nested within
individuals into latent between-person means and within-person dynamic
deviations (`centering = "latent"`), avoiding Nickell bias while jointly
modeling random intercepts, random autoregressive/covariate slopes, random log
innovation variances (`logv | y`), between-level predictors, and distal
outcomes.

```{r}
library(DSEMr)

dat_2l <- simulate_dsem(
  n = 25, clusters = 12, intercept = 0.5, ar = 0.45, sigma = 0.7,
  random_sd = c(0.3, 0.08, 0.15), id = "subject", time = "time", seed = 91
)

m_ls <- dsem_model("
  level: 1
    s | y ~ lag(y, 1)
    logv | y ~~ y
  level: 2
    y ~~ s + logv
    s ~~ logv
", id = "subject", time = "time")

fit_ls <- dsem(m_ls, dat_2l, chains = 2, iter = 300, warmup = 150, seed = 92)
coef(fit_ls)
dsem_dic(fit_ls)
head(dsem_inspect(fit_ls, "random_effects_summary"))
```

Within-cluster standardized autoregressive and covariate effects (averaged over
clusters at each MCMC draw) are computed with `dsem_standardize()`:

```{r}
dsem_standardize(fit_ls, type = "stdyx")
```
